identity.name: Solana Bay at Avenir
identity.notes: Solana Bay at Avenir is an intimate gated enclave of 118 modern single-family homes by Akel Homes, located on Avenir's largest lake in Palm Beach Gardens, FL. One- and two-story residences range from 2,274 to 4,200 sq ft with 3-6 bedrooms and 3-7 bathrooms. Starting from $948.9K. Features a trio of cascading waterfalls at the entrance and lakefront setting.

fees.note: Official Akel Homes FAQ: 'the community Solana Bay at Avenir has a homeowners' association (HOA) fee of $258 per month.' Covers common area maintenance, landscaping, community amenities, and security per builder marketing pages. Note: residents also pay a separate Avenir CDD assessment on the property tax bill (amount unverified). Confidence 0.9 (official builder source). Retrieved 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z. (Confidence field set below.)

Listing-site FAQ: 'fees typically range from $200-350 monthly depending on your specific section within the community.' Conflicts with official $258 figure; reported as separate version. Confidence 0.5 (reputable listing site, unverified).

Second FAQ entry on same listing page (dated Dec 28, 2023): 'HOA fees in Solana Bay typically range from $300-500 monthly, covering community amenities, landscaping, and common area maintenance.' Conflicts with both the official $258 figure and the $200-350 range; reported as separate version. Confidence 0.5.

open_questions: Avenir CDD annual assessment amount: Avenir CDD (established 2017 under Chapter 190, Florida Statutes) collects annual assessments via the Palm Beach County Tax Collector, appearing in the non-ad valorem section of the property tax bill. Candidate sources found but NOT read (read budget exhausted): avenircdd.org, lillyluxuryliving.com, southflinsider.com, wolfeofrealestate.com. Amount unverified.

Demographic detail (median age, median household income, owner-occupancy %, data year) for Palm Beach Gardens: Census Reporter profile page loaded only partially (population 60,959; 59.2 sq mi; 1,029 people/sq mi confirmed); detailed tables did not render.

Nearest shopping, grocery, library, and hospital distances: not found on any page read; a targeted search returned no results. Community is ~7 miles west of I-95 Exit 77 (Northlake Blvd) per builder FAQ.

Additional Avenir amenities listed on miamirealgroup.com (lap pool, 8-person spa, dog park, working farm + nature trails, 2 tot lots + kid's room, 8 tennis + 6 pickleball courts, splash pad, cafe + outdoor dining, Avenir Town Center) were NOT verified on a read page.
